edges.reason: _msgSender returns msg.sender directly.
msg.sender becomes the from address in _transfer.
transfer calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances.
msg.sender is used as spender when updating allowance in transferFrom.
_transfer delegates balance mutation to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute fee values.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call.
swapTokensForEth forwards tokenAmount into the external router swap call.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which pushes ETH out.
sendETHToFee passes half of the balance to each ETH transfer.
External router swap can re-enter the token contract before _transfer completes.
Native ETH transfer to fee wallets can re-enter the contract via receive().
block.timestamp drives the cooldown require/assignment in _transfer.
cooldown mapping compared and set against block.timestamp in _transfer.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
openTrading passes address(this).balance into addLiquidityETH.
openTrading assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth after a hardcoded wallet check.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee after a hardcoded wallet check.
manualswap authorizes based on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes based on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the authorization source for manualswap.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the authorization source for manualsend.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
_maxTxAmount bounds the amount inside _transfer.
inSwap gates the automatic swap block in _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap block in _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to in _transfer.
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist mapping.
renounceOwnership reads and clears the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner check compares _owner against _msgSender() in renounceOwnership.

contractETHBalance is read and forwarded to sendETHToFee inside _transfer.
